meta_description:
149 likes, 197 comments - drsnehal_adsule on September 18, 2026: "You’re eating the same way, trying the same things, but suddenly…

Your periods feel different.
Your sleep isn’t as restful.
Your mood feels all over the place.
Cravings are stronger.
You feel more tired than usual.
And the weight that once came off easily now feels SO much harder to lose.

But please don’t respond by simply eating less. 🫶🏻

Start by going back to the basics your body needs:

✨ Protein: Add a proper protein source to every main meal. Think dal, eggs, chicken, fish, paneer, curd or tofu.

✨ Strength training: Aim for 2–3 sessions a week. Building and maintaining muscle becomes increasingly important as we get older.

✨ Sleep: Try to keep your sleep and wake-up time consistent. Your body loves rhythm more than perfection.

✨ Stress: If you’re constantly juggling work, family, responsibilities and everyone else’s needs, your mental load matters too.

✨ Track your symptoms: Don’t look at the weighing scale alone. Notice changes in your periods, sleep, energy, mood, cravings and digestion.

And one important thing…

Not every symptom is “just hormones.”

If a change is new, severe, unusual or persistent, talk to your doctor and get it checked rather than assuming you simply need to “try harder.”

Your body isn’t failing you❤️

You may simply need a different approach for the body you have today, not the body you had 10 years ago.

I’ve put together a simple 3-Day Hormone & Mind Reboot Guide to help you understand where to start without overwhelming yourself.

👇 Comment RESET and I’ll send it to you.".
